subject: How do I convert Lists into R vectors?

messages.author: 8d2307d50b30e3f7
messages.subject: How do I convert Lists into R vectors?
parts:
Hi,

I'm very new to R and Renjin.  I have some data in the form of  ArrayLists that I'd like to manipulate in R.  I seem to be able to access and assign the array successfully, but if I try to manipulate it I get an EvalException:

import(MyData);
import(java.util.ArrayList);

data <- MyData$new();
array <- c(data$getMyArrayList());
min(array)   <---- Boom...

org.renjin.eval.EvalException: invalid 'type' (list) of argument
    at org.renjin.primitives.Summary$RangeCalculator.addList(Summary.java:134)
    at org.renjin.primitives.Summary.min(Summary.java:44)
    at org.renjin.primitives.R$primitive$min.apply(R$primitive$min.java from WrapperSource:60)
    at org.renjin.eval.Context.evaluateCall(Context.java:247)
    at org.renjin.eval.Context.evaluate(Context.java:179)
    at org.renjin.primitives.special.AssignLeftFunction.assignLeft(AssignLeftFunction.java:60)
    at org.renjin.primitives.special.AssignLeftFunction.apply(AssignLeftFunction.java:44)
    at org.renjin.eval.Context.evaluateCall(Context.java:247)
    at org.renjin.eval.Context.evaluate(Context.java:179)
    at org.renjin.primitives.special.BeginFunction.apply(BeginFunction.java:46)
    at org.renjin.eval.Context.evaluateCall(Context.java:247)
    at org.renjin.eval.Context.evaluate(Context.java:179)
    at org.renjin.eval.Context.evaluate(Context.java:170)
    at org.renjin.sexp.Closure.doApply(Closure.java:108)
    at org.renjin.eval.ClosureDispatcher.apply(ClosureDispatcher.java:80)
    at org.renjin.eval.ClosureDispatcher.applyClosure(ClosureDispatcher.java:65)
    at org.renjin.sexp.Closure.apply(Closure.java:82)
    at org.renjin.eval.Context.evaluateCall(Context.java:247)
    at org.renjin.eval.Context.evaluate(Context.java:179)
    at org.renjin.eval.Context.evaluate(Context.java:170)
    at org.renjin.script.RenjinScriptEngine.invoke(RenjinScriptEngine.java:232)
    at org.renjin.script.RenjinScriptEngine.invokeFunction(RenjinScriptEngine.java:201)
    at org.renjin.script.RenjinScriptEngine.invokeFunction(RenjinScriptEngine.java:19)

Is this error a typing problem ie. Does the ArrayList have to be declared ArrayList<Some type T, say Double>?  Are there any examples available for back and forth array conversion? Thanks for any insight.

=Ron=

messages.author: f06db63329fab1f9
messages.subject: Re: How do I convert Lists into R vectors?
parts:
Hi Ron,
Right now, Renjin doesn't implicitly convert java collection objects to R objects -- so your "array" looks like an "external ptr" to the min() function, which is expecting a vector.

Renjin will however implicitly convert arrays of double[] to R objects that can be passed to R functions, so you might try array.toArray(Arrays.newArray...etc)

Implicit conversion from java.util collection objects on calls to functions might be very nice though, so open an issue on github if you think it's something worth having.

Best,
Alex

messages.subject: Re: How do I convert Lists into R vectors?
parts:
Hi Alex!

Thanks, indeed that did the trick... funny thing was I actually thought I had tried this, but I realized after you reply that I must have been returning Doubles, not doubles.  Does the interpreter handle the other primitives and Strings as well? Admittedly I know very little about R, but from what I can tell it does seem to me that the ability to implicitly handle List would be very valuable for operating. Its a little, but really only a little painful, to do the conversion on my side, so I guess I'd leave it to the authors to decide if its worth the effort.  Perhaps it would be good to add an example involving Lists to the Calling Java Classes from R section in the wiki. Again, Thanks!

=Ron=
